sloka: तां तु भार्यां स निर्भर्त्स्य सो ऽब्रवीत्सुमहातपाः ।दुर्विनीते विनिध्वंस ममाश्रमसमीपतः ।। ७.३०.३७ ॥
transliteration: tāṁ tu bhāryāṁ sa nirbhartsya so 'bravītsumahātapāḥ ।durvinīte vinidhvaṁsa mamāśramasamīpataḥ ।। 7.30.37 ॥

translations.english: Having rebuked his wife, the great ascetic then said, "O ill-behaved one, disappear from the vicinity of my hermitage!"
